name: Easy Strider Living
label: Quest
description: In Auberdine, Alanndarian Nightsong offers to share her strider stew recipe with hunters who bring her foreststrider meat.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Alanndarian Nightsong offers to share her strider stew recipe with hunters who bring her foreststrider meat.

Auberdine's coastal folk make use of the wildlife around them. Alanndarian Nightsong has her own recipe for hearty strider stew, made from the tall foreststriders that roam Darkshore's woods. She asks you to hunt the birds and bring back their meat before she shares her cooking.

Foreststriders range through the woodlands and beaches north and south of Auberdine. Their sharp beaks and quick tempers make them dangerous when provoked, but their meat makes a rich stew. Bring fresh meat to Alanndarian, and she will share her recipe.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, friend--fresh strider stew. Delicious!
Perhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?
Before I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.
Now, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Fantastic! Try it and tell me what you think, friend!
